title: Childhood games and the Johnson-Willard fight
summary: His favorite games were baseball and boxing; his father took him to see Jack Johnson fight Jess Willard, and he describes the fight and the claim it was fixed.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: Uh - huh. And what were your favorite games as a child? Do you remember?
Baseball, boxing - as a matter of fact, I saw Jack Johnson and Jess Willard fight.
You saw the Jess Willard - Jack Johnson fight. What do you remember about that? Who took you to the fight?
Ah - ha - And do you have any memories of what happened that day?

Well, there was so much commotion, it was in the daytime, it was so hot, you know, I was very very little, you know, but I remember when Willard, there was about 15 or 20 rounds, maybe more, it was a long fight, but that was very funny, very funny to me; naturally I didn't have too much knowledge about fighting, but I saw Jack Johnson when he put up his glove to cover, cover up the sun with the glove - you know, it looked funny and everybody was saying that it was a fake.
I see. Did - - Was that the impression with most of the people? That Jack Johnson threw that fight?
